::: {#exm-normal-equations-slr}
#### Normal equations of a simple linear regression

For a simple linear regression,
the parameter vector is $\vcoef \eqdef \tp{\paren{\intcoef, \coef{x}}}$,
and $\text{RSS}(\vcoef)$ is $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ from @exm-rss-slr.
Its gradient has one entry per coefficient,
so the normal equations (@def-normal-equations) are two scalar equations:

$$
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef} = 0,
\qquad
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x}} = 0.
$$
:::
